newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Utd.Drug says rights issue completed.
newsitem.headline: Utd.Drug says rights issue completed.

text.p: Irish pharmaceutical distribution group United Drug Plc said on Tuesday that its rights issue to raise approximately 12.4 million Irish pounds, net of expenses, had been successfully completed.
The company said in a statement that 84.6 percent of the shares offered were taken up by qualifying shareholders.
It said 4,456,376 new ordinary shares were issued at a price of 290 Irish pence per share on the basis of one new ordinary share for every four ordinary shares held.

United Drug said new ordinary shares not taken up by qualifying shareholders were sold in the market at a price of 315 Irish pence, a premium of 25 Irish pence per share over the issue price, and this premium, net of commission, will be distributed amongst the non-accepting shareholders.
